case_description: Targeted malware campaign initiated in the cyber range. Phishing email delivered a payload to a Lab Host/Endpoint; NG-SIEM raised a malware alert; case opened by NG-SOC Operator with SIEM context attached.

tasks.title: Attach NG-SIEM alert + correlated logs
tasks.description: Import the NG-SIEM alert (rule 100101/100103) and firewall/AV/host logs (UML step 7).

tasks.title: Enrich IOCs from CTI-SS (MISP)
tasks.description: Pull malware family / TTPs / related IOCs from MISP (UML step 8).

tasks.title: Map attack path / confirm targeted attack
tasks.description: UEBA + log correlation; confirm as targeted attack (UML step 6).

tasks.title: Trigger NG-SOAR containment
tasks.description: Isolate host, block C2 IP, reset credentials, quarantine endpoint (UML steps 9-10).

tasks.title: Share malware intel via CTI-SS
tasks.description: Publish IOCs + relevant playbooks to the sharing group (UML step 12).

tasks.title: Post-incident analysis
tasks.description: Identify entry point and improvement areas; feed cyber-range evaluation (UML step 13).
